items.title: Incorrect Authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce leading to privilege escalation
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce could allow an attacker to gain elevated access to sensitive resources without user interaction.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce leading to security feature bypass
items.summary: Adobe Commerce is affected by an incorrect authorization vulnerability that could result in a security feature bypass, allowing a low-privileged attacker to gain unauthorized read and write access.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update resolves critical and important vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, including arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, including arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Unauthenticated arbitrary file upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload vulnerability in the Amasty Order Attributes extension for Magento allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, potentially leading to remote code execution.
